scientific_integrity: The analytic proof establishes sharpness for every n>=3. Finite executable checks are corroborating only. Primary references were compared to the theorem; an unlocated prior extremal reciprocal-Herfindahl theorem is a residual bibliographic possibility. No independent validation or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Known positive real abundances, a single additive merger of two species, and order-two Hill diversity; neither sampling error, taxonomic hierarchies, simultaneous multiple mergers, nor other diversity orders are covered. Exact optimization does not establish a causal biodiversity loss.
title: Sharp loss of Hill–Simpson effective richness under a single taxonomic merger
